decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out several products that were actually accessories like carrying cases, charging cables, and replacement batteries. My consideration set focused on actual speakers with strong user ratings. Among these, the Sony SRS-XB43 was the clear winner despite its higher price point. It offers the best combination of build quality (IP67), battery life (24h), and modern features (USB-C) compared to the older Bose model. While the NOTABRICK and Comiso speakers offered good value, the Sony's reputation for 'Extra Bass' and high ratings from a large volume of reviewers made it the most reliable choice for a primary audio device.
